finalText:
**Migrated 12 files off `db.query`.** All 33 call sites now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Modules load clean.

I left `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9)` alone. Its header says edits are lost on upgrade. Two calls there still use the old form.

Next: pin a `legacy-orm` version that ships `execute`, or wrap the adapter.
